$comment: Proposed initial content of .github/audit-ignore.json (BL-2124, SEC-R08). Read by scripts/ci/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs an id, a reason and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); a reasonless or expired entry fails the gate. Built from a live `npm audit --omit=dev --json` on develop 00c93e3 on 2026-11-24: 6 vulnerable packages at high, 10 high advisory ids, 0 critical. Never run `npm audit fix --force`.

Build tool only: schema checks inside the Expo CLI on the developer machine and in CI. The app's own code does not import this copy. Clears with an Expo CLI release on zod 4.6.6 or later.

Runs in the app: Expo Router parses deep-link query strings with it. The advisory is a denial of service on a crafted query string (a hang, not a data read). Clears when expo-router moves off query-string 7; npm names a semver-major expo-router as the fix, so it waits for the Expo SDK upgrade.
